comments.headline: Missing vertical clearance verification for driveways and parking
comments.summary: No vertical clearance dimensions provided from driveway and parking finished grades to lowest point of overhead electric facilities. Mid-span conductor sag data and minimum clearance verification (16-18 feet) missing for Type III driveway crossings.
comments.crossDep: Austin Energy — conductor elevation and mid-span sag measurements required
comments.attn: Type III driveways crossing overhead lines require registered surveyor mid-span clearance field measurements. Clearance appears potentially marginal based on site grading plan.

details.text: No vertical clearance dimensions from driveway and parking finished grades to lowest overhead conductor point. Mid-span conductor sag survey data not provided. Minimum 16-foot (parking without truck traffic) or 18-foot (with truck traffic) vertical clearance cannot be verified. Two Type III driveways cross overhead line without documentation.

runComments.comment: No vertical clearance dimensions shown from driveway/parking finished grades to lowest point of overhead electric facilities. Two Type III driveways at site entries/exits cross the overhead electric line. No vertical clearance dimensions are shown on site plan or grading plan. No survey data from registered surveyor documenting mid-span clearances is provided. Compliance with 18-foot minimum vertical clearance (for areas with truck traffic) cannot be verified without detailed clearance survey.

Overhead electric lines confirmed on site. comments.headline: Landscaping mitigation trees positioned within electric easement without species verification
comments.summary: Landscape plan shows mitigation tree canopies overlapping marked overhead electric line and positioned within 5-foot easement boundaries. Proposed tree species lack verification as utility-compatible per ECM standards. Clearance verification dimensions and easement compliance unverifiable.
comments.crossDep: Austin Energy — easement boundary verification and clearance approval; City Arborist — species utility-compatibility certification
comments.attn: ECM Appendix F utility compatibility reference inaccessible in plan set. Tree species must be verified against approved 'UC' (Utility Compatible) list. Trees within 10 feet of distribution conductors must not exceed ~20 feet mature height.

details.text: Landscape plan shows mitigation trees positioned at or overlapping marked overhead electric line and within 5-foot electric easement boundaries. Tree list provided but cannot cross-reference species to utility compatibility without access to ECM Appendix F.

comments.headline: Missing pre-construction notification requirement for overhead electric facilities
comments.summary: Cover sheet and general notes lack required notation that owner/contractor must notify Austin Energy at least 48 hours before work begins near high-voltage overhead lines per Texas Health & Safety Code. Run 3 identifies existing transmission-specific note but questions applicability to distribution facilities.
comments.crossDep: Austin Energy — notification protocol clarification for transmission vs. distribution facilities
comments.attn: Run 3 notes existing 48-hour pre-construction safety meeting requirement on Sheet 3 Block 9, but identifies it as applying only to TRANSMISSION facilities (≥60kV), not DISTRIBUTION facilities (<60kV). Clarify whether existing transmission note adequately covers distribution work or separate distribution-specific note required per Texas Code § 752.003.

details.text: Cover sheet and general notes do not include required note per Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003, requiring owner/contractor to notify Austin Energy at least 48 hours before work begins near high-voltage overhead lines. Overhead electric distribution facilities present on and adjacent to entire site.

runComments.comment: Cover sheet and general notes do not include required note that owner/contractor must notify Austin Energy at least 48 hours before work begins near high-voltage overhead lines per Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003.

Overhead electric distribution line exists on site and construction is proposed. Required note per Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003 stating that owner/contractor must notify Austin Energy at least 48 hours before work begins near high-voltage overhead lines is not included on cover sheet or general notes.

Overhead electric lines confirmed present on and adjacent to site. Sheet 3, Block 9 contains a 48-hour pre-construction safety meeting note with Austin Energy, but this note applies specifically to TRANSMISSION facilities (voltage ≥60kV) and transmission easement work. No comparable 48-hour notification note identified that applies to DISTRIBUTION facilities (voltage <60kV) per Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003 requirement for work near high-voltage lines. Applicability of transmission-specific note to distribution facilities requires clarification.
